results.llm_raw: {"say":"The goal RuRu---- is the top half of the cut shape: the cutter's left output (B84) carries TL+BL (Ru--Ru--), so it needs one 90° turn before reaching the hub — inserting a rotator on that output belt is the smallest fix, leaving the by-product half to the existing trash line.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B84","asCell":true},"machine":"rotator","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"B84 is the cutter's left half (TL+BL filled); one rotation turns it into the required RuRu---- so the hub can start accepting deliveries."}]}

{"say":"Trash the unwanted cutter output so only the requested RuRu---- half remains.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B85","asCell":true},"machine":"trash","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"C1's B84 side is the wanted half; B85 is the other half and should be consumed instead of blocking the line."}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis and nothing is reaching the hub, so I want to convert the empty miner-fed run into the goal shape: cut the full shapes at the head of the M3 chain so the existing run toward the balancer/hub carries RuRu----.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B112","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"The M3 feed run is empty end-to-end; putting a cutter in-line at its head turns the mined full shape into the required half shape that the existing downstream belts already carry toward the balancer/hub, and replacing the occupied belt keeps the footprint atomic."}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis was produced, so I go for the goal directly: the hub already has feeder belts but nothing has been delivered, so I place a cutter on the belt that feeds the hub to turn full Ru shapes into the RuRu half the level wants; I leave the machine un-rotated and let the macro work out the footprint and slot alignment from the existing layout.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B135","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"Put a cutter directly on the hub feed belt so shapes arrive cut as RuRu halves instead of full shapes, which is why delivery stays at zero"}]}
